title: Phreesia’s Sophia Wagner Named to Becker’s 2026 List of Health IT & Revenue Cycle Up-and-Comers
summary: Phreesia is proud to announce that Sophia Wagner, Vice President of Product Engineering, has been named to Becker’s Hospital Review’s 2026 list of Health IT & Revenue Cycle Up-and-Comers.

-

**ALL-REMOTE COMPANY/WILMINGTON, Del. — Nov. 3, 2026 —** Phreesia, a leader in patient intake, outreach and activation, is proud to announce that Sophia Wagner, Vice President of Product Engineering, has been named to *Becker’s Hospital Review* ’s 2026 list of[Health IT & Revenue Cycle Up-and-Comers (this link opens in new window)](https://www.beckershospitalreview.com/healthcare-information-technology/72-health-it-revenue-cycle-up-and-comers-2026/) .


The list recognizes emerging leaders at hospitals, health systems and healthcare companies who are advancing technology, improving financial performance and guiding organizational growth. Becker’s developed the list through nominations and editorial research.


In her current role, Sophia leads teams across product management, engineering and operations, supporting Phreesia’s payments and provider financing businesses. She sets product vision and guides execution for a portfolio that includes payment facilitation and processing, financing, patient payments, and patient billing and statements. Her responsibilities include oversight of nearly $5 billion in annual payment processing volume and continued development of provider financing capabilities following Phreesia’s acquisition of AccessOne.


“Sophia is one of the sharpest, most resilient leaders I know,” said Kristin Roberts, Senior Vice President of Product at Phreesia. “She combines rigorous critical thinking with a deep command of the revenue cycle market and has a rare ability to turn opportunity into meaningful impact for both Phreesia and our clients.”


“Being recognized by Becker’s is an honor,” said Sophia Wagner, Vice President of Product Engineering at Phreesia. “The most rewarding part of my work is bringing teams together to turn a product vision into something that helps patients and healthcare organizations. I’m grateful to work with colleagues who care deeply about the details and share a commitment to making the financial side of healthcare easier.”


For more information on Phreesia, visit[phreesia.com](https://www.phreesia.com/) .


## About Phreesia


Phreesia is the trusted leader in patient activation, giving healthcare providers, life sciences companies and other organizations tools to help patients take a more active role in their care. Founded in 2005, Phreesia enabled approximately 180 million patient visits in 2025—1 in 6 visits across the U.S.—scale that we believe allows us to make meaningful impact. Offering patient-driven digital solutions for intake, outreach, education and more, Phreesia enhances the patient experience, drives efficiency and improves healthcare outcomes. To learn more, visit phreesia.com.
